Problem management and root-cause analysis Identify recurring incidents and underlying systemic problems. Lead or contribute to root-cause analysis. Recommend permanent corrective and preventive actions. Change and release support Assess the impact of fixes, configuration changes, and ERP updates. Perform functional/system testing and coordinate business validation when appropriate. Support deployments and post-deployment verification. Monitoring and operational support Monitor critical ERP processes, scheduled jobs, integrations, and interfaces. Investigate failures proactively where monitoring is available. Ensure critical business processes are restored within agreed service levels. Ticket and SLA management Own assigned incidents through resolution rather than simply forwarding them. Prioritize according to severity and business impact. Maintain clear, accurate ticket documentation and regular communication with users. Knowledge management Document solutions, known errors, troubleshooting procedures, and recurring issues. Create knowledge articles that enable Level 1 to resolve more incidents independently. Share knowledge with other ERP support team members. Business and IT coordination Act as a bridge between business users and technical teams. Translate business symptoms into technical/functional requirements for specialists. Communicate technical findings in language understandable to business stakeholders. CRITICAL CAPABILITIES Excellent written and verbal communication skills. ERP Functional Expertise Strong understanding of core ERP processes and assigned functional areas (BaanIV, Infor LN, or Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012). Ability to understand how transactions flow across modules. Ability to distinguish process, configuration, master-data, and system issues. Advanced Troubleshooting & Root-Cause Analysis Systematic investigation of complex incidents. Identify symptom vs. root cause. Analyze application errors, logs, jobs, interfaces, and transaction history. Develop and validate workarounds when immediate resolution is unavailable. Integration & End-to-End Process Understanding Understand ERP interfaces with upstream and downstream applications. Trace transactions across systems. Determine where a failure occurred and which team/application owns it. Understand dependencies between ERP, middleware, databases, reporting, and external systems. Incident Ownership & Prioritization Take ownership from escalation through resolution. Assess business impact, urgency, and priority. Drive resolution across multiple technical or functional teams. Maintain clear communication with impacted users and stakeholders. Technical Analysis Ability to investigate application logs, batch processes, queues, interfaces, and error messages. Basic understanding of databases and data structures. Ability to perform data analysis and queries where appropriate. Understand enough of the ERP technical architecture to engage effectively with developers and infrastructure teams. Requirements EDUCATION: Bachelor's Degree/College Diploma in a technical discipline (Engineering or IT related) EXPERIENCE: 3+ years of experience as an ERP application support or ERP analyst preferred. 3+ years of process improvement, data, or technology project experience would be a strong asset. 2+ years of experience working with BaanIV, Infor LN or Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012. Support managers and associates in addressing people-related matters, balancing business needs with legal and policy requirements. Associate Lifecycle & Talent Management Be responsible for HR activity through the associate lifecycle across our Central Europe corporate offices and retail stores, supporting both associates and managers where needed. Lead and manage recruitment and selection end-to-end when required, directly handling roles in addition to overseeing team delivery, across multiple countries. review_candidates.description: Murphy deploys AI agents for banks starting with the most straightforward business case: voice AI for debt collection . We’ve built a fully-fledged platform designed to optimize recovery rates while maintaining respectful and personalized communication. Our AI-powered agents adapt instantly, engaging with debtors across channels like voice, messengers, email and SMS to maximize results while preserving trust. We’re live with Santander, Revolut, BBVA and dozens others. We’ve proven the product in large-scale pilots with top-tier banks. And now we need to move fast to secure leadership in this $300Bn+ industry . About The Team Our mid-market customers need a collections agent that works within weeks. To do that for many customers at once, we rely on standard workflows, reusable components and strong tooling, tuned to each customer segment. Forward Deployed Engineers on the mid-market team launch these agents and keep improving the system behind them. Each launch should be faster and more reliable than the last. About The Role As a Forward Deployed Engineer on the mid-market team, you run several implementations in parallel, each taking a customer from kickoff to a live agent in about four weeks. You configure agents on Murphy's platform using our templates, adapt them to each customer, and test them before launch. After go-live, you track how each agent performs, explain the results to the customer, and tune the agent and contact strategy. Over time, you improve those templates and tools so the whole team can deliver more with less effort. This is also where new FDEs at Murphy learn the craft. Strong mid-market FDEs move on to our enterprise team, which builds custom deployments for banks. You'll be based in São Paulo and launch agents for lenders, telcos, utilities, healthcare providers and servicers in Brazil. In this role, you will Run multiple mid-market implementations at the same time, from kickoff to go-live, on a fixed timeline. Configure and adapt agents from our segment templates to each customer's policies, products and tone. Configure how and when we reach debtors: call windows, retry and frequency rules within each country's regulations, channel mix (voice, SMS, RCS, WhatsApp), payment links and hand-offs to human agents. Set up customer data imports and exports using our standard integration flows. Test agents with simulations and evaluations before launch, and fix what fails. Analyze production performance (contact rates, promises, payments, funnel) with SQL and dashboards, explain results to customers, and turn findings into agent or strategy improvements. Spot repeated work across implementations and turn it into templates, scripts or tooling. Help shape the standard workflow for each segment (telco, utilities, healthcare, servicers, lenders). Hand over live customers to our Deployment Strategists with clear documentation. Share product gaps and customer feedback with Product and Engineering. Your background looks something like this 1 to 3 years in a technical role: software engineering, solutions engineering, implementation, technical support or technical consulting. Strong graduates are welcome too. You write Python and/or TypeScript and SQL, work with APIs and handle data files. You like structured, repeatable work and look for ways to automate it. You manage several projects at once and keep each one on schedule. You communicate clearly with customers and teammates. Native-level Portuguese and fluent English. Even better if you have Hands-on experience with LLMs: prompting, evals or building small agents. Exposure to collections, lending, telco, utilities or other customer operations. A Computer Science, Engineering or Math degree, or equivalent experience. What we offer 💰 Competitive salary , based on your skills, experience and impact. 📈 Stock options : Because we all build Murphy together – you'll own a piece of what we’re creating. 🧩 Impact : Be part of our startup journey from day one, playing a key role in our growth and building something meaningful from the ground up. 📚 Learning : Continuous development through trainings, knowledge-sharing, and exposure to other top-tier startups in our ecosystem. 🛜 Hybrid & Flexible : Our default setup is hybrid – 3 days a week at our office in São Paulo and 2 days of remote work. But if there’s one thing that defines us, it’s flexibility: we trust you to organize your time and space in the way that helps you do your best work. Our Process 1️⃣ First Interview – Getting to Know You A conversation with a future teammate who’s excited to find a new colleague. We’ll talk about your story, what drives you, and what you’re looking for next—no trick questions, just a genuine exchange. 2️⃣ Second Interview – Deep Dive You’ll meet the Hiring Manager and potentially another team member. This is a more technical discussion where we explore your skills in detail, walk through real scenarios, and answer any questions you might have about the role. 3️⃣ Tech Assessment or Business Case A practical exercise to see how you approach challenges similar to those you’d tackle at Murphy. You’ll have time to reflect and showcase your thinking—no rush, no surprises. 4️⃣ Call with the Founders Our founders meet every team member and it’s a great opportunity for you to learn about the company and its direction. 👉 To learn more about how we hire and what to expect at every step, feel free to explore our Hiring Guide! 👉 We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace where everyone, regardless of background, identity, or experience, feels valued and empowered to thrive. We believe that different perspectives drive innovation and success, and we actively foster an environment where all voices are heard and respected.

Role purpose Drive capital raising and investment distribution for Lesha Bank’s offerings across private capital, aviation, infrastructure, real estate and public equities. Acquire and develop relationships with high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth individuals, family offices and other eligible investors, converting these relationships into funded investments and repeat participation in the Bank’s offerings. Key responsibilities Capital raising and business development Raise capital and attract client allocations into Lesha Bank’s investment offerings, delivering agreed fundraising, net new money and revenue targets. Develop and execute distribution plans for investment opportunities across private capital, aviation, infrastructure, real estate and public equities. Originate new investor relationships in Qatar and approved regional markets through professional networks, referrals and targeted outreach. Increase investment participation from existing clients by identifying suitable opportunities aligned with their objectives. Manage the fundraising pipeline from prospect identification through investor engagement, commitment, subscription and funding. Maintain accurate forecasts and report on fundraising progress, expected inflows and conversion rates. Investor relationship management Manage an assigned portfolio of investors, understanding their investment objectives, risk appetite, liquidity needs and allocation preferences. Build long-term relationships with investors, family offices and their advisers through regular meetings and proactive communication. Present investment opportunities clearly, explaining the investment rationale, structure, fees, potential returns, material risks and liquidity or exit considerations. Coordinate investor presentations and due diligence discussions with the Bank’s investment specialists. Maintain engagement after investment, coordinating timely updates on performance, distributions and material developments. Investment knowledge and collaboration Develop a thorough understanding of the Bank’s offerings across the five investment areas and their respective risk and return characteristics. Work with investment teams to communicate investment propositions accurately and respond to investor enquiries. Provide feedback on investor demand, allocation preferences and reasons for declining opportunities to inform product development and distribution strategy. Coordinate with Operations, Legal, Compliance and other relevant teams to ensure timely onboarding, documentation, subscriptions and funding. Risk management and conduct Ensure investment distribution and recommendations meet applicable client eligibility, suitability, regulatory and Shari’a requirements. Complete client due diligence in coordination with Compliance, including source of wealth and source of funds documentation. Observe approved offering terms, cross-border marketing restrictions and the Bank’s policies. Explain relevant investment risks transparently, including market volatility, illiquidity, concentration, capital loss and uncertainty over returns or exit timing. Maintain complete records and promptly escalate financial crime concerns, conflicts of interest and material client issues. Key performance indicators Capital raised and net new money against agreed targets. Funded subscriptions and allocations across the Bank’s investment offerings. Investment distribution revenue. New funded investor relationships. Repeat investment and investor retention. Pipeline conversion and forecast accuracy. Investor service quality and compliance with required controls. Qualifications and experience Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration or a related discipline; a relevant postgraduate degree or professional qualification is an advantage. Typically 10–15 years of relevant experience in private banking, wealth management, investment distribution or capital raising. Strong understanding of private and public market investments, including the ability to explain different investment structures, risks and liquidity profiles. Familiarity with Shari’a-compliant investment solutions, suitability and client due diligence. Strong presentation, negotiation and relationship management skills, with commercial judgment and disciplined execution. Fluent English; Arabic preferred.
